scope: All 525 HEROES_DB universes, using universe and mode only. A concrete scene name or description overrides the default reference and can select another profile or none.
mechanismGeometry: 40 individual empty-prop mechanisms in 20 new roster universes; no generated anatomy or character silhouettes.

preservationEvidence.note: SHA256 of Canvas commands at 1040x460, at zero and 23 percent of each period, with no Image in Node. Not pixel hashes or source-frame fidelity verification.

localAssetInventory.method: Read-only relevant filename inventory. Names do not prove source suitability, specific map geometry or official frames.
